issues.reason: The rule invoked ("With VP-ellipsis reconstruct the verb") presupposes an antecedent the text does not supply — the reviewer's own gap — and in that gap territory the emitted atoms (a past doing by her) are true and well-typed, so the calibration line makes the improvisation acceptable.

Coordination & plurals: "Coordinated noun phrases are distributive by default — replicate the whole predication once per conjunct", and the one-event-many-fillers form is licensed only for reciprocal/aggregate predicates (meet, gather, assemble, collide) or bare "together"/"jointly", none of which covers `include`.

"and then some" has no licensed carrier (the reviewer's own gap), and the instruction set explicitly prefers omission over mis-slotting an unrepresentable adverbial — "leave the unrepresentable adverbial out rather than mis-slot it" — so dropping it adds nothing false and is the prescribed handling.

gaps_confirmed: VP-ellipsis ("She did") whose antecedent verb phrase lies outside the sentence being translated — the reconstruction rule has nothing to reconstruct from.
The emphatic idiom "and then some" (scalar "and more than that") — no carrier.
Privative / temporal adjectives on a noun ("former winners") — approximated here by Past-wrapped typing atoms.
"as well as" as a coordinator — the additive focus-particle list has bare "as well", not the coordinating phrase, so no Also tag is clearly licensed or required.
new_gaps: A free participial adjunct on the matrix clause ("She did …, besting a 144-player field") has no licensed link atom, so the besting event floats unrelated to the matrix event — and with the pro-form "did" reified as its own `do` event, one eventuality ends up split across two unlinked witnesses.
repair_summary: Split the single include event with three Theme atoms into three distributed events (sk_include_1/2/3), each with the field as Agent, one conjunct as Theme, and its own Past.
notes: Everything else is untouched: the `do` event, the omitted "and then some", the 144-player field NP and the Past-wrapped "former winners" typing all stand.
